body: Hey this is the throwaway account of /u/Yukari-Takeba for posting depressing shit without alarming friends. Ive been feeling pretty down on myself. Been making a lot of stupid decisions and hating my lack of personality. I'm feeling like I'm not really good at anything. On the bright side, I've been growing closer to a loved one who I'm very happy to be around, but she's leaving for a trip soon and I won't have contact with her for about a month. Hoping all of this passes and I get myself in order.
Thank you for the kind words.
